scope: Review-specific project allocations, not normative risk classifications or new ASILs

scenarios.scenario: Older but still authenticated/age-valid primary overrides newer authenticated backup
scenarios.mitigation: Choose latest authenticated same-producer issued time; do not compare unverified admission timestamps
scenarios.residual: Both paths stale/lost, compromised producer and trusted-clock failure remain open

scenarios.scenario: One historical pressure peak generates repeated current-pressure diagnostics after queues clear
scenarios.mitigation: Current backlog/new drops and explicit 100 ms clear-dwell state machine
scenarios.residual: DTC remains latched; diagnostic recovery does not establish safe actuation or malicious-cause identification
